+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING — COMPOSITION rung 2: a full `def` DECLARATION, in one Rian module
+# ===========================================================================
+# `selfhost_compose.rian` composed lex → parse → lower → forms over an
+# *expression* — but the test still built the surrounding Erlang function form
+# (params, clause, name, arity) in Elixir glue. This rung widens the composed
+# subset to a whole DECLARATION:
+#
+#     def f(a, b) := a + b * 2
+#
+# and emits the COMPLETE `{:function, L, Name, Arity, [{:clause, …}]}` abstract
+# form in Rian. The declaration parser (def-head + parameter list + `:=` body)
+# and the function/clause/param assembly now live here, not in the test:
+#
+#     compile_def(s) = emit_def(parse_def(lex(s)))
+#
+# The only Elixir left in `test/rian/compose_decl_fixpoint_test.exs` is the two
+# module-level attribute forms (`{:attribute,_,:module,_}` / `:export`) — the
+# export list needs a *tagless* `{name, arity}` tuple, which Rian's variant
+# lowering (every ctor injects a tag atom) cannot spell. Everything that depends
+# on the SOURCE — name, arity, params, body — comes from Rian. The host FFI is
+# still just `String.to_atom` (the operator/variable/function-name atoms),
+# counted in @selfhost_ffi.
+#
+# Scope grows from "expression" to "single-clause function over arithmetic".
+# Multi-clause heads, patterns, and guards are the next widening.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod SelfhostComposeDecl do
+  # ── shared pipeline types ──
+  type Tok := TNum(String) | TId(String) | TOp(String) | TLP | TRP | TComma
+  type Surface := SNum(String) | SId(String) | SBin(String, Surface, Surface)
+  type Core := CNum(String) | CId(String) | CBin(String, Core, Core)
+
+  # a parsed declaration: name, parameter names, body expression.
+  type Decl := Def(String, Vec(String), Surface)
+
+  # ErlForm IS the Erlang abstract-form grammar for the expression subset.
+  type ErlForm := Integer(Int53, Int53)
+                | Var(Int53, Symbol)
+                | Op(Int53, Symbol, ErlForm, ErlForm)
+
+  # the function/clause wrappers — these lower to the EXACT Erlang forms:
+  #   Clause   -> {:clause,   L, Params, Guards, Body}
+  #   Function -> {:function, L, Name, Arity, Clauses}
+  type Clause := Clause(Int53, Vec(ErlForm), Vec(ErlForm), Vec(ErlForm))
+  type Func := Function(Int53, Symbol, Int53, Vec(Clause))
+
+  # ── the composed entry point: source -> Erlang function form ──
+  pub def compile_def(s String) Func := emit_def(parse_def(lex(s)))
+
+  # ── stage 1: lex (String -> tokens) ──
+  pub def lex(s String) Vec(Tok) := lex_chars(Prim.str_chars(s))
+
+  def lex_chars(Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_chars([]) := []
+  def lex_chars([c | rest])
+    if c == 32 do
+      lex_chars(rest)
+    else
+      classify(c, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def classify(c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def classify(c, rest)
+    if is_digit(c) do
+      take_num([c | rest], [])
+    else
+      lex_alpha_or_op(c, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def lex_alpha_or_op(c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_alpha_or_op(c, rest)
+    if is_alpha(c) do
+      take_id([c | rest], [])
+    else
+      take_op([c | rest])
+    end
+  end
+
+  def take_num(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_num([], acc) := [TNum(text(acc))]
+  def take_num([c | rest], acc)
+    if is_digit(c) do
+      take_num(rest, [c | acc])
+    else
+      [TNum(text(acc)) | lex_chars([c | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def take_id(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_id([], acc) := [TId(text(acc))]
+  def take_id([c | rest], acc)
+    if is_alnum(c) do
+      take_id(rest, [c | acc])
+    else
+      [TId(text(acc)) | lex_chars([c | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  # `:=` (58, 61) and `,` (44) join `(`/`)` as punctuation; everything else is an op.
+  def take_op(Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_op([58, 61 | rest]) := [TOp(":=") | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([44 | rest]) := [TComma | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([40 | rest]) := [TLP | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([41 | rest]) := [TRP | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([c | rest]) := [TOp(Prim.str_from_chars([c])) | lex_chars(rest)]
+
+  def text(acc Vec(Int53)) String := Prim.str_from_chars(rev_codes(acc, []))
+
+  def rev_codes(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Int53)
+  def rev_codes([], out) := out
+  def rev_codes([c | rest], out) := rev_codes(rest, [c | out])
+
+  def is_digit(c Int53) Bool := c >= 48 and c <= 57
+  def is_alpha(c Int53) Bool := (c >= 65 and c <= 90) or (c >= 97 and c <= 122) or c == 95
+  def is_alnum(c Int53) Bool := is_alpha(c) or is_digit(c)
+
+  # ── stage 2a: parse the declaration head (def NAME ( params ) := body) ──
+  # the leading `def` token is consumed and ignored (always present by contract).
+  pub def parse_def(Vec(Tok)) Decl
+  pub def parse_def([_ | rest])
+    case rest do
+      [TId(name) | r2] -> parse_params(name, r2)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_params(name String, Vec(Tok)) Decl
+  def parse_params(name, [TLP | rest]) := collect_params(name, [], rest)
+
+  # collect parameter names until `)`, then expect `:=` and parse the body.
+  def collect_params(name String, acc Vec(String), Vec(Tok)) Decl
+  def collect_params(name, acc, [TRP | rest]) := finish_def(name, rev_strs(acc, []), rest)
+  def collect_params(name, acc, [TComma | rest]) := collect_params(name, acc, rest)
+  def collect_params(name, acc, [TId(p) | rest]) := collect_params(name, [p | acc], rest)
+
+  # the token after `)` is `:=`; consume it and parse the remaining expression.
+  def finish_def(name String, params Vec(String), Vec(Tok)) Decl
+  def finish_def(name, params, [_ | rest]) := Def(name, params, parse(rest))
+
+  def rev_strs(Vec(String), Vec(String)) Vec(String)
+  def rev_strs([], out) := out
+  def rev_strs([s | rest], out) := rev_strs(rest, [s | out])
+
+  # ── stage 2b: parse the body expression (tokens -> Surface, precedence climbing) ──
+  type PR := PR(Surface, Vec(Tok))
+
+  pub def parse(ts Vec(Tok)) Surface
+  pub def parse(ts)
+    case parse_bp(0, ts) do
+      PR(e, _) -> e
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_bp(min_bp Int53, ts Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_bp(min_bp, ts)
+    case primary(ts) do
+      PR(lhs, rest) -> climb(min_bp, lhs, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def climb(min_bp Int53, lhs Surface, ts Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def climb(min_bp, lhs, [TOp(op) | rest])
+    if lbp(op) >= min_bp do
+      case parse_bp(rbp(op), rest) do
+        PR(rhs, rest2) -> climb(min_bp, SBin(op, lhs, rhs), rest2)
+      end
+    else
+      PR(lhs, [TOp(op) | rest])
+    end
+  end
+  def climb(min_bp, lhs, ts) := PR(lhs, ts)
+
+  def primary(Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def primary([TNum(n) | rest]) := PR(SNum(n), rest)
+  def primary([TId(x) | rest]) := PR(SId(x), rest)
+  def primary([TLP | rest])
+    case parse_bp(0, rest) do
+      PR(e, [TRP | rest2]) -> PR(e, rest2)
+      PR(e, other) -> PR(e, other)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def lbp(op String) Int53 := bp_base(level(op))
+  def rbp(op String) Int53 := bp_base(level(op)) + 1
+  def bp_base(lvl Int53) Int53 := (13 - lvl) * 10
+
+  def level(String) Int53
+  def level("*") := 3
+  def level("+") := 4
+  def level("-") := 4
+
+  # ── stage 3: lower (Surface -> Core) ──
+  pub def lower(Surface) Core
+  pub def lower(SNum(t)) := CNum(t)
+  pub def lower(SId(n)) := CId(n)
+  pub def lower(SBin(op, l, r)) := CBin(op, lower(l), lower(r))
+
+  # ── stage 4: emit (Decl -> Erlang function form) ──
+  # the function NAME stays a lowercase atom (`:f`); parameters and body
+  # identifiers become capitalised Erlang variables (`a` -> `:A`).
+  def emit_def(Decl) Func
+  def emit_def(Def(name, params, body)) := Function(1, String.to_atom(name), len(params), [Clause(1, param_vars(params), [], [forms(lower(body))])])
+
+  def param_vars(Vec(String)) Vec(ErlForm)
+  def param_vars([]) := []
+  def param_vars([p | rest]) := [Var(1, String.to_atom(cap(p))) | param_vars(rest)]
+
+  def len(Vec(String)) Int53
+  def len([]) := 0
+  def len([_ | rest]) := 1 + len(rest)
+
+  # expression -> Erlang abstract form (identifiers capitalise to Erlang vars).
+  def forms(Core) ErlForm
+  def forms(CNum(t)) := Integer(1, parse_int(t))
+  def forms(CId(n)) := Var(1, String.to_atom(cap(n)))
+  def forms(CBin(op, l, r)) := Op(1, String.to_atom(op), forms(l), forms(r))
+
+  def parse_int(s String) Int53 := digits(Prim.str_chars(s), 0)
+  def digits(Vec(Int53), Int53) Int53
+  def digits([], acc) := acc
+  def digits([c | rest], acc) := digits(rest, acc * 10 + c - 48)
+
+  def cap(s String) String
+    case Prim.str_chars(s) do
+      [c | rest] -> Prim.str_from_chars([up(c) | rest])
+      [] -> s
+    end
+  end
+
+  def up(c Int53) Int53
+    if c >= 97 and c <= 122 do
+      c - 32
+    else
+      c
+    end
+  end
+end

+defmodule Rian.ComposeDeclFixpointTest do
+  # async: false — loads real modules into the VM via :code.load_binary.
+  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
+
+  alias Rian.Beam
+
+  # COMPOSITION fixpoint rung 2 (ADR-0063 Step 3): widens the composed subset from
+  # an *expression* (compose_fixpoint_test) to a full single-clause `def`
+  # DECLARATION. `selfhost_compose_decl.rian` now parses the def head + parameter
+  # list + `:=` body AND assembles the complete Erlang function form in Rian —
+  # `compile_def(s) = emit_def(parse_def(lex(s)))` — so name, arity, params, and
+  # body all come from the SOURCE, not from Elixir glue.
+  #
+  # The only Elixir residual is the two module-level attribute forms
+  # (`:module` / `:export`): the export list needs a *tagless* `{name, arity}`
+  # tuple, which Rian's variant lowering (every ctor injects a tag atom) can't
+  # spell. Both the name and arity in that boilerplate are READ BACK from the
+  # Rian-produced function form — nothing source-dependent is authored here.
+  #
+  # As before, this compiles + loads + RUNS the result and asserts it behaves
+  # identically to the full Elixir toolchain (`Rian.Beam` on the same `def`).
+
+  setup_all do
+    {:ok, mod} =
+      Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_compose_decl.rian"), :rian_compose_decl)
+
+    {:ok, mod: mod}
+  end
+
+  # build, compile, and load a module from the Rian-produced function form. Only
+  # the :module/:export attribute boilerplate is Elixir — name + arity are read
+  # back out of the Rian form, not re-derived from the source.
+  defp compose_module(mod, src, modname) do
+    {:function, _l, name, arity, _clauses} = func_form = mod.compile_def(src)
+
+    forms = [
+      {:attribute, 0, :module, modname},
+      {:attribute, 0, :export, [{name, arity}]},
+      func_form
+    ]
+
+    {:ok, ^modname, bin} = :compile.forms(forms, [:return_errors])
+    {:module, ^modname} = :code.load_binary(modname, ~c"nofile", bin)
+    {modname, name, arity}
+  end
+
+  # the Elixir toolchain compiling the reference declaration.
+  defp ref_module(src) do
+    {:ok, m} = Beam.load(src, :"cmp_decl_ref_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")
+    m
+  end
+
+  # {pipeline source (untyped — the arithmetic subset has no type syntax),
+  #  reference source (typed Rian for Rian.Beam), function name, [arg lists]}.
+  # The two strings are the SAME function; the fixpoint compares runtime behavior.
+  @corpus [
+    {"def f(a, b) := a + b", "def f(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := a + b", :f, [[2, 3], [10, -4]]},
+    {"def f(a, b, c) := a + b * c", "def f(a Int53, b Int53, c Int53) Int53 := a + b * c", :f,
+     [[1, 2, 3], [5, 6, 7]]},
+    {"def f(a, b, c) := (a + b) * c", "def f(a Int53, b Int53, c Int53) Int53 := (a + b) * c", :f,
+     [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]},
+    {"def f(a, b, c) := a - b - c", "def f(a Int53, b Int53, c Int53) Int53 := a - b - c", :f,
+     [[10, 3, 2]]},
+    {"def g(x) := x * 2 + 1", "def g(x Int53) Int53 := x * 2 + 1", :g, [[20]]},
+    {"def h() := 2 + 3 * 4", "def h() Int53 := 2 + 3 * 4", :h, [[]]},
+    {"def f(foo, bar) := foo * bar + 1", "def f(foo Int53, bar Int53) Int53 := foo * bar + 1", :f,
+     [[6, 7]]}
+  ]
+
+  describe "composition fixpoint — a full `def` (Rian) runs identically to Elixir" do
+    test "the composed declaration compiles + runs a function equal to Rian.Beam's", %{mod: mod} do
+      for {rian_src, ref_src, fname, inputs} <- @corpus do
+        {composed, name, _arity} =
+          compose_module(mod, rian_src, :"cmp_decl_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")
+
+        assert name == fname, "composed function name diverged for `#{rian_src}`"
+        ref = ref_module(ref_src)
+
+        for args <- inputs do
+          assert apply(composed, fname, args) == apply(ref, fname, args),
+                 "composed `def` diverged from Elixir toolchain on `#{rian_src}` with #{inspect(args)}"
+        end
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "teeth — the whole function form is built in Rian (name, arity, params, body)" do
+    test "compile_def emits a complete {:function, …} abstract form", %{mod: mod} do
+      assert mod.compile_def("def f(a, b) := a + b * 2") ==
+               {:function, 1, :f, 2,
+                [
+                  {:clause, 1, [{:var, 1, :A}, {:var, 1, :B}], [],
+                   [{:op, 1, :+, {:var, 1, :A}, {:op, 1, :*, {:var, 1, :B}, {:integer, 1, 2}}}]}
+                ]}
+    end
+
+    test "arity and param vars come from the source's parameter list", %{mod: mod} do
+      {:function, 1, :sum3, 3, [{:clause, 1, params, [], _body}]} =
+        mod.compile_def("def sum3(x, y, z) := x + y + z")
+
+      assert params == [{:var, 1, :X}, {:var, 1, :Y}, {:var, 1, :Z}]
+    end
+
+    test "a zero-arg def yields arity 0 and an empty parameter list", %{mod: mod} do
+      assert mod.compile_def("def answer() := 6 * 7") ==
+               {:function, 1, :answer, 0,
+                [{:clause, 1, [], [], [{:op, 1, :*, {:integer, 1, 6}, {:integer, 1, 7}}]}]}
+    end
+  end
+end
